$comment: Bentley Mills is a commercial carpet mill on WordPress + WooCommerce with the Restoration theme (child theme restoration-child) and a custom product layout: the product name is an h2 in the #product-detail-view header bar (no h1), and the page has no canonical link, so product.url is the requested URL. Product URLs are /product/<number>-<slug>/ (from mvc_product-sitemap.xml). There is no price, cart or stock text: products are specified and sampled through reps ('Order Samples'), so price and availability are not configured and every product returns price.state unknown with a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. There is no product description text in the page either. The image is the first gallery image (img.image.first-image, CloudFront or wp-content). Specs come from the SPECS modal (#specifications-info): one div.info-wrapper per row with a span.info-wrapper-title name and a p value (24 rows on the sample: product type, collection, dye method, construction, gauge, fiber, recycled content, pattern repeat, ...). Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title, image and 24 specs; browser: same data, slower; duckduckgo, mojeek, yandex: SEARCH_PROVIDER_BLOCKED; yahoo: SEARCH_PROVIDER_ERROR; brave: not tried, no key; ai-crawler-avalai: title, image and only 5 specs at 1,517+660 tokens; ai-crawler-avalai web_search: 18 specs, unverified, no image (561+450 tokens); ai-crawler-cloudflare: not configured. http is selected: the most data at no cost. Checked against saved (curl) Agnona (broadloom) and Expo Hall (carpet tile) pages on 2026-11-19.
